binary.layout: byte0 kind | bytes1..6 uint48 big-endian seq | bytes7.. raw terminal bytes
binary.zero_length: rejected as BAD_MESSAGE (a data message always carries at least one byte; end of session is session.exit/Close, never an empty payload)
binary.seq: starts at 1, strictly +1 per direction per session; uint48 is exactly representable in an ECMAScript Number (2^48 < 2^53); the connection is ended before 2^48-1

ack_semantics.acceptedSeq: highest input seq accepted into this process's bounded RAM — not executed, not durable
ack_semantics.executedSeq: highest input seq that had been delivered to the shell when a command line last COMPLETED under this epoch
ack_semantics.consumedSeq: highest contiguous output seq the client has handed to its renderer

credit.creditBytes: cumulative total of output payload bytes the client has authorized for this session; the server sends output only while sentBytes + next <= creditBytes
